rec.name: Testimonial Carousel with Product Review Cards
rec.status: Reference only (ticket notes the element already exists)

what.text: A horizontal testimonial carousel section. The left column holds a tag icon, a headline with an aggregate review claim (screenshot shows 'Over 80,000+ 5-star reviews'), a short supporting paragraph, and previous/next arrow buttons. The right side shows a row of review cards. Each card has a tall customer photo (a person wearing the product), the product name in caps, the reviewer's first name, a 5-star rating, a short review text, and a heart-emoji line reading 'Product is still recommended'.

why.text: A large review count in the headline gives instant aggregate social proof. Photos of real customers wearing the product make the reviews feel authentic and help shoppers picture the item on themselves. Named reviewers, star ratings and a 'recommended' line add peer validation and lower purchase risk.

how.text: Build a section with a left intro block (icon, heading, rich text, arrow controls) and a scrollable or slider track of review blocks. Each block takes an image, product title, reviewer name, star rating, review text and a recommendation line. Arrow buttons scroll the track. Exact slider behavior, responsive layout and data source (manual blocks vs. a review app) are not specified in the ticket.

items: Review blocks: customer image, product name, reviewer name, star rating, review text, recommendation line

dependencies.text: Not specified in the ticket. If review content is dynamic it likely needs a reviews app or metaobjects; customer photos need to be uploaded. The ticket links a Figma design for the Nordlichtstore store, and a comment says the element already exists.

items: Click-through rate from testimonial cards to the PDP
Conversion rate of sessions that see the section
